en.headline: Hong Kong Alliance and two former leaders found guilty of inciting subversion
en.dek: A High Court panel sitting at West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts convicted the disbanded group, Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung; Albert Ho earlier pleaded guilty and all face sentencing later.
body: A three-judge High Court panel on Friday found the Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China, its former chairman Lee Cheuk-yan and former vice-chairwoman Chow Hang-tung guilty of one count of inciting others to subvert state power under the National Security Law.

The offence carries a maximum penalty of 10 years’ imprisonment. Sentencing was adjourned. Former vice-chairman Albert Ho Chun-yan had pleaded guilty at the start of the trial in January and remains in custody pending sentence.

The court ruled that the Alliance’s longstanding operational objective of “ending one-party dictatorship” amounted to an intention to overthrow or undermine the fundamental system of the People’s Republic of China and the central organs of state power, and that the defendants had incited others to pursue that goal by unlawful means between July 2020 and September 2021.

Lee, 69, and Chow, 41, had denied the charge and remained in custody throughout the proceedings. The Alliance, represented by counsel appointed by the Official Receiver after its dissolution in September 2021, also pleaded not guilty. The trial lasted 24 days.

zh.headline: 支聯會及兩名前領導被裁定煽動顛覆國家政權罪成
zh.dek: 高等法院三名國安法指定法官裁定已解散的支聯會、前主席李卓人及前副主席鄒幸彤罪名成立；何俊仁早前認罪，各人稍後判刑。
body: 高等法院三名國安法指定法官周五在西九龍裁判法院（暫代高等法院）裁定，已解散的香港市民支援愛國民主運動聯合會（支聯會）、前主席李卓人及前副主席鄒幸彤，一項煽動他人顛覆國家政權罪罪名成立。
該罪最高可判監禁10年。法庭押後判刑。前副主席何俊仁早於今年1月開審時認罪，目前還押等候判刑。
法庭裁定，支聯會長期沿用的「結束一黨專政」綱領，等同意圖推翻或破壞中華人民共和國憲法所確立的國家根本制度及中央政權機關，而各被告於2020年7月至2021年9月期間煽動他人以非法手段追求該目標。
69歲的李卓人及41歲的鄒幸彤否認控罪，審訊期間一直還押。支聯會於2021年9月解散後由破產管理署委任律師代表，同樣不認罪。案件共審理24日。
